readme:
# Daijob Jobs Scraper Scrape job listings from Daijob ([daijob.com](https://www.daijob.com/)), the bilingual job board for international careers in Japan. You get the title, company, location, salary, position level, Japanese and English language levels, badges and a short description for every job. Turn on job details to add the full description, requirements, working hours, holidays, nearest station, job categories, industries and company details. Search by keyword and filter by career level, employer type, company features, job category, industry, location, Japanese level and salary. ## What you get - One row per job, with clean ISO dates and salary numbers (minimum, maximum and currency) where the job shows a salary. - The language level the job asks for in every language, with the site's level code, and the Japanese level as its own column. - Optional job page fields: description, requirements, company information, working hours, other salary information, holidays, nearest station, contract period, job categories, industries, company features and the apply link. - Each job once per run, even when several keywords find it. - A run with no input returns 5 jobs for the keyword marketing. ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/daijob-jobs-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `daijob-jobs-scraper` to find up to 5 jobs for the keyword "marketing" (bilingual marketing roles). Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "includeDetails": false, "maxResults": 5, "maxResultsPerQuery": 5, "searchQueries": [ "marketing" ] } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `searchQueries` | Keywords such as marketing, sales or engineer. Each keyword is its own search. Leave empty with a filter to read the latest jobs. | | `careerLevels` | Position level: entry, junior, mid, senior or staff level (names as on the site). Several values are allowed. | | `accountTypes` | Who posts the job: employer, recruiter or staffing agency. | | `companyFeatures` | Company features such as Remote Work, Five Days Workweek or International Team (the names of the site's feature list). | | `jobCategories` | Job categories as on the site, for example `Sales/AE - IT Sales`. A name used in two categories needs its category in front. | | `industries` | Industries as on the site, for example Pharmaceuticals or Games. | | `sortBy` | Sort order of the site, for example Newest or Updated date. Empty keeps the site order. | | `locations` | Places such as Tokyo or Osaka. Rows whose location text does not contain one of them are dropped. | | `japaneseLevels` | Required Japanese level, for example Native or Fluent. Rows with another level are dropped. | | `minSalaryJpy` | Minimum yearly salary in yen. Rows with a lower top salary, no salary or another currency are dropped. | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Jobs per keyword. Default 50, up to 1000. | | `maxResults` | Jobs in total. 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Read each job page for the extra fields. Default false. | A filter value the site does not know gives no rows and a status message that names the value. Locations, Japanese level and salary are applied by the actor on the pages it reads (up to 25 pages per search), so a narrow filter on a broad search can find fewer jobs than exist. ## Sample output ```json { "id": "1562046", "title": "【Sales】English & Spanish", "company_name": "スカルネ・ジャパン株式会社", "employer_type": "Employer", "recruiter_name": null, "company_logo": "https://www.daijob.com/images/uploads/19254/551412-8db-f12ca.jpg", "position_level": "Staff Level", "position_level_stars": 2, "locations": [ "Asia > Japan > Tokyo > Chiyoda" ], "countries": [ "Japan" ], "regions": [ "Tokyo" ], "salary_text": "JPY 4000K Over", "salary_min": 4000000, "salary_max": null, "salary_currency": "JPY", "salary_negotiable": false, "japanese_level": "Native Level", "japanese_level_code": 6, "language_levels": [ { "language": "English", "level": "Business Conversation Level (TOEIC 735-860)", "code": 4 }, { "language": "Japanese", "level": "Native Level", "code": 6 }, { "language": "Spanish", "level": "Business Conversation Level", "code": 4 } ], "snippet": "🍖 Bringing the passion and quality of Mexico to tables in Japan and across Asia. 🍖\n\nWe are seeking individuals to promote and distribute the globally acclaimed \"Scarne\" brand of beef to major domestic restaurant chains, family restaurants, convenience stores, and popular independent restaurants. There is a small start fee for each run (`apify-actor-start`) and a fee for each job in the dataset (`job-result`). You pay only for jobs that are delivered, and a run stops cleanly when it reaches the maximum cost you set. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0009 per job result ($0.90 per 1,000 jobs). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. ## Related Actors - [JobKorea Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobkorea-kr-scraper): Jobs from JobKorea, a major job board in South Korea. - [foundit.in Job Scraper: India, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/foundit-in-scraper): Jobs from foundit in India and Southeast Asia. - [Indeed Jobs Scraper - 60+ Countries, $0.06 per 1,000 Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/indeed-http-scraper): Indeed jobs in over 60 countries. ## FAQ **Does it need a login or an API key?** No. It reads the public result pages and job pages of daijob.com. **Why do I get fewer jobs than the site shows?** The site lists jobs in pages of 20. A run stops at the limits you set, when the list ends or when the cost limit is reached. Filters that the actor applies itself (locations, Japanese level and salary) look at up to 25 pages per search. **What does a run with 0 jobs mean?** The status message says "0 jobs found for" and the search. The site had no job for that keyword or filter. If the site could not be reached, the run fails with a message that starts with Blocked, so an empty result is never a hidden error. **Which fields are always filled?** Id, title, job URL and the run fields are always there. Company, salary and levels are filled when the job shows them; otherwise they are null. Fields from the job page appear only when job details are on. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/daijob-jobs-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
